question: How is the constant washing of the mouth reinterpreted in relation to Brahman?
premises: Constant washing of the mouth is mentioned.
It is directed upward toward Brahman.
The instruction is addressed to a beloved.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as being directed upward toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The phrase may be symbolic rather than literal.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
